propositions: a rejected tickets-branch auto-push succeeds locally and reports success to the caller, while the actual push is silently rejected by GitHub push protection, causing local commits to diverge from remote undetected

the rejection reason captured by git (stderr) is discarded due to over-broad matching on the token 'rejected' in the _NON_FF regex, which misclassifies policy declines as retriable non-fast-forward conflicts
ticket event payloads are never scanned for secrets on write; while gitleaks gates code review, comments containing raw environment output with credentials are not protected
the PUSH_PENDING divergence signal is only computed by fsck (a pull-only operation) and never re-announced on subsequent writes, allowing eight hours of accumulation to pass silently
the unpushed commit count is not included in push failure warnings, making recurring failures indistinguishable and preventing visibility of an escalating backlog
on sync.push=async the warning is spawned as a detached process with stderr redirected to /dev/null, making rejection completely undeliverable to the calling agent
